_doc: Body needs (GDD §3 'status of body and mind', §11). Meters run 0..100, 0 = fine. Per-hour rates run on the hourly tick, meals / water / medicine on the morning upkeep. A stamina effect is a mul on max_stamina. Until 1.7 brings daily life, a survivor sleeps in the schedule's hours and works the rest. Every number here is Claude's unless a note says GDD.

fatigue.note: GDD: builds all day, lowers max stamina, goes with sleep in a bed. Short Sleeper (rest_need) scales the gain; Marathon (fatigue) scales the stamina loss; Night Owl tires 25 % faster by day

hunger.note: GDD: too hungry lowers stamina, too long costs health. Fed every morning; a missed meal starts starving (100) the next morning, about 12 health a day

thirst.note: GDD: thirsty = drinks the flood water = may get sick. Flood water is everywhere, so thirst never kills

injury.note: GDD: light / heavy (fracture, open wound, burn); heavy needs days in the infirmary (1.7) and keeps the survivor home. Without medicine (GDD §11) it heals at half speed. Endurance (injury_severity) shortens it; Fast Healer (heal_rate) speeds it

sickness.note: GDD: from rain, dirty water, rotten food; spreads in the base (contagion is per sick housemate, each morning). Weak Immune (sickness_chance) ×2; Iron Stomach is immune to the dirty sources; Robust (illness_recovery) shortens it; medicine takes a day more off each day

infection.note: GDD: from a bite or spores without a mask; 3 days (GDD) to find an antiviral, else choose: exile, quarantine or end their life. Quarantine buys quarantine_days more for an antiviral, then they turn (die). Resistant (infection_chance) lowers the bite chance
